title: AutoDNA: an AI-native autonomous laboratory for biomolecular engineering
summary: AutoDNA orchestrates over 20 instrument types across more than 11,000 steps to run nucleic acid synthesis, transcription, amplification and sequencing with human input limited to hardware maintenance. The authors report four representative applications. Limits: the abstract does not give per-application metrics beyond the stated scope.
ai_technology: AutoDNA AI-native autonomous laboratory (co-designed models, experiments and instruments)
organization: Institute of Parallel and Distributed Systems

evidence.tested: Autonomous execution of multi-objective nucleic acid experiments across diverse instruments, in four representative applications.
evidence.unknown: Limits beyond the reported scope (human maintenance of reagents and labware) are not stated in the reviewed abstract.
evidence.ai_role: AI models co-designed with experiments and instruments orchestrate the end-to-end workflow autonomously.
